newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Kaltim Methanol says ahead of schedule.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Kaltim Methanol says ahead of schedule.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Kaltim Methanol Industri, controlled by President Suharto's son Hutomo Mandala Putra, said on Thursday its $350 million plant in East Kalimantan was ahead of schedule.
"We have already completed 55 percent of the contruction work so far, which is two months ahead of schedule," Kaltim Methanol president director Abdul Wahab told reporters.
Wahab said construction of the plant started in March last year.
Commercial operation was expected to start in December 1997, with production capacity of 2,000 tonnes methanol per day.
Kaltim Methanol is 100 percent owned by the widely-diversified Humpuss Group, controlled by Mandala Putra.
Wahab said he expected to export 60 percent of the firm's products and sell the remaining 40 percent in the domestic market.
Japanese trading house Nissho Iwai Corp had already expressed interest in selling the firm's products in Japan and Taiwan, Wahab said.
Wahab said 25 percent of the financing for the plant was met internally and the remaining 75 percent from overseas loans, mostly from Japanese banks.
